title: Shape companions

artDirection.material: Soft matte 3D forms with diffuse lighting
artDirection.color: One stable dominant hue per character; value shading only
artDirection.format: Original unmodified 4x4 source sheets plus locally registered performance atlases. Feature anchors drive eye, glove and posture deformation.

states.label: Happy
states.pose: Genuine cheerful eye-crinkle and big smile, arms relaxed slightly open, tiny pleased body lift. Distinct from the thumbs-up completion pose.
states.trigger: A positive conversational moment; never used alone as proof that work completed.
states.motion: Brief eye-crinkle and small bounce, then return to the current activity.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Curious
states.pose: One eyebrow raised, small body tilt, one white glove lightly at cheek, attentive small smile.
states.trigger: A new topic or user-invited exploration.
states.motion: Raise one brow, tilt and glance toward the topic, then settle.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Surprised
states.pose: Eyes noticeably wide, small round O mouth, both palms briefly held outward at chest level; surprise without fear.
states.motion: Quick widened eyes and tiny recoil, then recover.
states.exitAndControls: Continue current activity; do not replay repeatedly.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Confused
states.pose: Uneven brows, uncertain crooked closed mouth, clear small tilted pose, one glove near the top side as if scratching head.
states.trigger: The assistant cannot interpret a request with enough confidence.
states.motion: Small uneven brow and tilt, followed by a clear clarification question.
states.exitAndControls: Switch to needs-input if clarification blocks progress.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Concerned
states.pose: Inner brows gently raised, soft direct eye contact, small sympathetic closed mouth, one open hand reaching slightly forward; not crying.
states.trigger: A supportive conversational response or a recoverable problem.
states.motion: Soft gaze, gentle open palm, one small reassuring nod.
states.exitAndControls: Continue the appropriate activity; do not infer the user's emotion from appearance.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Playful
states.pose: One clear wink, jaunty smile, slight sideways lean, one hand making a playful small wave.
states.trigger: User chooses a playful tone or initiates play.
states.motion: One wink and a tiny jaunty wave.
states.exitAndControls: Return to current activity; suppress during errors and pending approvals.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Idle
states.pose: Relaxed neutral eyes and small closed smile, both hands resting by sides, feet planted; clear reference/rest pose.
states.trigger: The assistant is available and no task is executing.
states.motion: Small breathing motion and occasional complete blink.
states.exitAndControls: Accept text input; enter listening only when audio capture actually begins.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Listening
states.pose: Wide attentive forward gaze, mouth closed, slight forward lean, one cupped white glove beside the body as if listening.
states.trigger: Microphone permission is granted and audio capture is actively receiving user input.
states.motion: Attentive forward lean and a restrained acknowledgment nod.
states.timing: Quiet hold with sparse motion; no simulated mouth speech.
states.exitAndControls: Stop listening ends capture; show a persistent mic indicator outside the artwork.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Thinking
states.pose: Eyes look up and to one side, a white glove under the mouth/chin, gently furrowed brows, other arm relaxed.
states.trigger: The assistant is processing/planning and is not currently running a tool.
states.motion: Look up briefly, glove at chin, return gaze to center.
states.timing: 3–4 second subtle loop while actual processing continues.
states.exitAndControls: Switch to researching, working, answering or needs-input according to real events; Stop remains available.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Researching
states.pose: Eyes deliberately scan toward screen-right, upright alert pose, one white glove lightly above the eyes in a looking-out gesture, other hand low; no magnifying glass.
states.trigger: Retrieval, browsing or source inspection is actively running.
states.motion: Small reading sweeps with pauses, then a downward reset.
states.exitAndControls: Show the current source/task label; waiting on a remote service uses waiting, not fake reading.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Working
states.pose: Focused eyes directed slightly down, mouth closed, both gloves in front at waist height making small precise task gestures, steady stance.
states.trigger: An action such as writing, coding, generating or testing is executing.
states.motion: Steady downward focus, small precise glove movements, occasional checking pause.
states.exitAndControls: Show the actual action, progress only when measurable, and Stop/Pause if supported.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Answering
states.pose: Friendly engaged forward gaze, open speaking mouth, one hand open in an explanatory presenting gesture, the other lower.
states.trigger: A response is being delivered as text or audio.
states.motion: Open-palm explaining gesture with soft eye contact.
states.timing: Gesture once per thought; natural quiet pauses.
states.exitAndControls: Mouth motion follows actual audio if speaking; text-only responses use a quiet mouth; interruption returns to listening or idle.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Needs Input
states.pose: Patient questioning eye contact, one brow raised, both open palms clearly facing upward in a balanced shrug, mouth small and closed.
states.trigger: Execution is blocked on a user answer or explicit approval.
states.motion: Patient questioning glance and one open-palm invitation, then rest.
states.timing: One entry gesture, then mostly still.
states.exitAndControls: Ask one clear question; show Answer or Approve/Decline as appropriate; never auto-approve.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Complete
states.pose: Pleased smile, decisive clearly visible thumbs-up with one white glove, tiny celebratory heel lift, other hand relaxed.
states.trigger: All requested work is confirmed successful.
states.motion: One thumbs-up, small pleased lift, then settle.
states.exitAndControls: Keep a durable result link/message after the pose ends; partial results do not trigger full success.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Error
states.pose: Brief concerned asymmetric brow and small uneasy mouth, one open palm turned outward in a gentle pause signal, both feet planted; recoverable problem, not rage or panic.
states.trigger: A task or tool action failed and cannot continue without recovery.
states.motion: One concerned pause signal, then attentive neutral stance.
states.timing: 0.8–1.5 second entry gesture, then hold calmly.
states.exitAndControls: Show what failed and Retry, Edit request or Dismiss; preserve any completed output.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

states.label: Sleeping
states.pose: Both eyelids fully closed, relaxed small smile, hands resting loosely, body inclined slightly to one side, both boots supported. No bed, no Z letters.
states.trigger: The assistant is explicitly resting and no foreground or background task requires a visible status.
states.motion: Slow eye closure and a gentle lowered posture.
states.timing: 2–3 second transition, then still; optional minimal breathing.
states.exitAndControls: Wake on explicit user interaction; do not imply ongoing work is finished or hide active microphone capture.
states.delivery: Local source-art deformation in the standalone viewer

systemVariants.label: Starting…
systemVariants.controls: Cancel if startup can be interrupted.
systemVariants.exit: Idle when ready; error if startup fails.

systemVariants.label: Waiting for a result…
systemVariants.trigger: An external tool or queue has not returned; no active local work.
systemVariants.controls: Stop; show elapsed time when useful, not invented completion percentages.
systemVariants.exit: Resume the task when the result arrives; error on timeout.

systemVariants.label: Writing code…
systemVariants.trigger: Code generation or editing is actually running.
systemVariants.exit: Checking or answering according to actual workflow.

systemVariants.label: Checking…
systemVariants.trigger: A real verification step is running.
systemVariants.exit: Complete only on successful verification, otherwise error or partial result.

systemVariants.label: Approval needed
systemVariants.trigger: A permission-sensitive action awaits explicit consent.
systemVariants.controls: Approve / Decline, with the exact action and destination visible.
systemVariants.exit: Resume only on approval; decline leaves the action unperformed.

systemVariants.label: Paused
systemVariants.trigger: A user pause has actually been acknowledged.
systemVariants.exit: Resume the saved activity; indicate pending pause until it takes effect.

systemVariants.label: Stopped
systemVariants.controls: Start again; keep completed output available.

systemVariants.label: Offline
systemVariants.controls: Reconnect / Retry; identify any available local-only actions.
systemVariants.exit: Restore prior task only if it can safely resume; otherwise ask.

systemVariants.label: Access needed
systemVariants.controls: Review permission / Choose another method / Cancel.
systemVariants.exit: Continue only with a permitted method.

systemVariants.label: Partly done
systemVariants.trigger: Some requested work completed but some remains blocked or failed.
systemVariants.exit: Complete only when the remaining work succeeds.

rules: Actual activity is the base state; emotion is an optional brief expression overlay.
Needs-input, awaiting-approval, error, offline and paused states interrupt progress-like motion.
An expression never changes the base task state, microphone state, completion status or permission outcome.
An emotion returns to the activity that is current when the reaction ends, not the one that started the reaction.
One-shot success and error poses do not loop. Persistent information remains in text.
Character hue is identity and never changes to signal task status.
Listening is shown only during actual audio capture; listening pose alone is not a microphone permission indicator.
Eyes and limbs may move; preserve the shape silhouette, glove/boot colors and overall visual mass.
128 browser performances are included. No live assistant, microphone, speech synchronization, production 3D rig or new state video exports are claimed.

animations.method: Generated sequential poses, boot registration, timed holds and optical-flow interpolation. Not a rigged 3D model. Original eyelid poses are retained through each blink.
animations.remainingStates: All fifteen other states per character are implemented as local browser artwork performances.

performances.method: Registered original art with independent eye, glove and posture deformation; short crossfades between source poses. No external generation or uploads.
performances.reducedMotion: Still artwork by default; live preference changes pause video and procedural playback; explicit Play opts into a preview.
